div.head: Ine 15.1
div.ab: Se að sceal beon healf be huslgengum.
Se að sceal bion healf be huslgengum.
Et debet esse medietas (iurantium) per hulsgengas (id est duodecimhyndos).
Se að sceal bion healf be huslgengum.
The oath shall be half for a communicant.
An oath equal in value to half the amount shall be shall be sufficient in the case of communicants.
With communicants, the oath shall be [only] half as much.
Der Eid soll halb [so stark] sein bei Abendmahlsgängern.
The oath is to be half [as strong] in the case of communicants.
